awakening_task_doc: Solo farming for the selected Kirin and floor, with optional team preset and awakening-material buff; count completed victories and stop on purchase or insufficient-stamina prompts.
bondling_search_task_doc: Navigate to the Bondling Fairyland explore page and repeat solo explores, counting completed victories; supports team lock, team preset, auto-ready and ally green mark. Stops when three explore clicks fail to start a battle (five bondlings already found), or on purchase or insufficient-stamina prompts.
project_description: Onmyoji Assistant. Image technology + simulation control, free your hands! Powered by MaaFramework!
team_member_task_doc: Works for any dungeon: wait on any page for the named leader's invite, join the battle, then wait for the next invite. Fails on defeat or after 5 minutes without an invite. Pick your battle shikigami in the game beforehand; the task never changes your lineup.
mitama_task_doc: Enter Soul Zones from the courtyard and repeat until the configured count or insufficient AP
common_activity_task_doc: Repeat the battle from the event screen until the configured count is reached
current_activity_task_doc: Repeat the battle from the current screen until the configured count is reached
exploration_task_doc: Navigate to the configured chapter or continue the current chapter; find sword icons and count completed settlements. Optionally stop on the map or chapter entrance once raid tickets reach a threshold.
realm_raid_task_doc: Navigate to personal Realm Raid, skip cleared cards and attempt each at most once. Stops when the ticket counter reads 0. Optionally retreats n times on the first card before fighting it, marks a friendly unit, switches team preset, and on a real defeat skips the card, refreshes or stops. Never buys tickets.
daily_rewards_task_doc: Claim mail and Flower Battle rewards with claim buttons. Excludes chests, paid rewards and limited events.
